scientific_caveat: The archive explicitly labels the s20 products as low-resolution quick-look/educational products and not intended for scientific analysis. They are used here only to validate the end-to-end image-level pipeline before higher-fidelity HST products are ingested.
admission: A candidate is interesting only if it survives the spatial null distribution and persists across at least two independent filters. This pilot is a known positive control, so any finding here is not a new-discovery claim.
